name: Cybercrime Proceeds
description: Laundering of funds from ransomware, business email compromise, investment and romance scams, hacking and account takeover. Money mules, rapid cross-border transfers, crypto conversion and cash-out services are typical.

sources.text: FATF, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-Enabled Fraud (2023)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
Europol, Internet Organised Crime Threat Assessment (IOCTA) (annual; specify year)

indicators.name: New account receives funds from many victims then moves them out
indicators.canon: Account receiving funds from multiple apparent fraud victims
indicators.desc: A new or low-activity account receives payments from several unrelated individuals who appear to be victims of fraud or phishing, followed by onward movement or cash-out.
indicators.ctx: Incoming payments from unrelated individuals followed by transfers abroad or to crypto.

indicators.name: Payment-instruction changes and urgent transfers to new beneficiaries
indicators.canon: Urgent payment instruction or payment-detail change outside normal process
indicators.desc: Staff receive urgent, confidential requests, or changes to beneficiary details, directing payment to a new beneficiary outside normal workflow.

indicators.name: Customers sending funds to crypto exchanges after being contacted by 'advisers'
indicators.canon: Customers sending funds to crypto exchanges after being contacted by 'advisers'

indicators.name: Ransomware-linked wallet exposure
indicators.canon: Exposure to wallets attributed to designated, stolen-fund or illicit actors
indicators.desc: Customer transacts directly or near-directly with blockchain addresses attributed by sanctions lists or analytics to designated persons, thefts, ransomware or terrorist fundraising.
indicators.ctx: Payments to wallets attributed to ransomware.

indicators.name: Account takeover indicators with immediate credential change and large outflows
indicators.canon: Credential or contact change followed by new payee and payments
indicators.desc: Password, email or phone details are changed, followed in the same session or day by a new payee and large outbound payments.

indicators.name: Rapid chain-hopping, mixers and privacy coin conversion
indicators.canon: Use of mixers, chain-hopping or privacy coins
indicators.desc: Funds are moved through mixers, privacy coins or rapid cross-chain conversion to obscure origin.
indicators.ctx: Funds move across tokens and chains.

indicators.name: Accounts opened with synthetic or stolen identities
indicators.canon: Inconsistent or synthetic identity data at onboarding
indicators.desc: Identity documents, contact details, geolocation or device data do not align, suggesting fabricated, stolen or misrepresented identity.

indicators.name: Cash-out through gift cards, prepaid, or money mules in other countries
indicators.canon: Cash-out through gift cards, prepaid, or money mules in other countries
